title: agent runner result
description: What a runner writes to $CIC_RESULT_JSON. Only `result` is required: a runner omits what its agent cannot report, and the factory leaves the corresponding meta.yaml field empty. Writing a zero where there is no measurement is forbidden -- a false zero looks like data, a missing field does not.

result.description: The agent's textual output. Raw text if the agent produced nothing parseable.

models.description: Comma-separated, every model the run touched.
